newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Svyazinvest tender has more than one bid - source.
newsitem.headline: Svyazinvest tender has more than one bid - source.

text.p: An auction for 25 percent plus one share in Russian telecom holding company Svyazinvest will take place since more than one bid has been made, a source close to the tender organising commission said on Tuesday.
Bidders, Russian or foreign, were required to transfer a $400 million deposit towards the $1.18 billion starting price by Monday. The auction officially ends on Friday.
The source did not say how many bids had been received. "There is more than one."
A Russian banking source representing one bidder said two bids had been made.
Representatives of the Unexim-MFK financial industrial group have said the group would bid. The Alfa group was also expected to bid but has made no such statement.

Svyazinvest is 100 percent owned by the state and sometimes likened to the Ministry of Communications since it holds controlling stakes in 88 regional and other telecom companies including Rostelekom long distance carrier.
Its fate is widely seen as one of the keys to the domestic telecom industry. A 24 percent stake will be sold later at an auction open only to Russian investors.
The commission which is selling Svyazinvest on behalf of the Federal Property Fund may not comment on bids while the auction is in process.
